title: Web Application Intrusion
story: Following the credential compromise, the SOC observed suspicious requests against the Black Falcon Bank web application. Multiple users accessed the portal during the same period, including legitimate administrators. Determine whether the web application was exploited and reconstruct the attacker activity.
objective: Correlate Suricata alerts, Zeek HTTP metadata, web access logs and application events to identify the attacker, exploitation technique, compromised endpoint and suspicious file activity.

questions.label: Identify the command executed through the web shell
